english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an established custom or generally followed practice.
Use this for an established customary practice or convention, especially one treated as an accepted rule rather than a personal habit.
Use this for an established usual practice rather than an imposed regulation.
Use 慣例 for an established custom or practice followed in a place or group.
Use this for a customary or usual way of doing something rather than for skill training.

examples.english: This practice has already become an industry convention.
examples.traditional: 呢個做法已經成為行業慣例。
